input.quote: Garman is the owner of all intellectual property rights in the Work (including any Improvements or Modifications thereto), including all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. No title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 13 vests ownership of all IP in the Work in Garman, expressly including the "Modifications" — which are the bespoke changes set out in Schedule "D" that we commission and pay for. Our only rights in them come from the Section 2 licence, which is non-exclusive, non-transferable, confined to Authorized Locations and (per Section 3) carries no right to modify or sublicense; that falls short of the fallback's perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables. Separately, the Agreement contains no statement that we retain rights in our own data, even though Garman converts and handles Sparkling's data under Section 4(b) (confidentiality in Section 14 protects but does not allocate ownership). Nothing assigns our IP or data to Garman, so this is not walk-away territory, and Garman's ownership of the Software platform and its Improvements is acceptable. The minimal redline adds a Sparkling data-ownership sentence and a licence back over the bespoke Modifications; Section 17(a) already makes the licence perpetual while fees are paid.

proposal.summary: Add Sparkling data ownership and a perpetual licence back to bespoke Modifications in § 13
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added confirmation that Sparkling retains all rights in its own data and materials and that nothing in this Agreement assigns our IP or data to Garman, together with a perpetual, royalty-free licence to use and modify the Schedule "D" Modifications developed for us. We are content for Garman to own its Software platform and its Improvements; our playbook simply requires customer data ownership and a licence back to deliverables we pay for.

ops.text: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Sparkling retains all right, title and interest in and to Sparkling's data and any materials, information or content supplied or generated by Sparkling (including data converted pursuant to Section 4), and nothing in this Agreement operates to transfer or assign any of Sparkling's intellectual property or data to Garman. Garman grants to Sparkling a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and have modified the Modifications, and any other deliverables developed specifically for Sparkling under this Agreement, for Sparkling's internal business purposes.
